body:
Founder real-time: "i need all the items in the readme for redgarden the old items are there
there are new items we need a full readme refresh."

Changes:
1. Documented substantial work missing since the README's last "Current Status" update
   (2026-07-23): the 3v3 queue (:7780) and team_rl_engage_nudge live consumer, the R&D vs Stable
   deployment split (2026-08-10), Jungle Camps/Four Heavenly Kings (all 5 milestones + GFD port),
   and the full arena bot AI research program (role discovery prerequisite, synergy decay,
   commander posture first step, noisy-gestalt training 100% eval, PFSP autocurriculum training
   75% eval, open founder-flagged decision points).
2. Updated the item catalog section + table: was documented as 27 items, is actually 33
   (ARENA_ITEM_COUNT) -- added the 3 pre-existing trinket/back items that were already missing
   from the table (Blink Dagger, Donkey, Haste Trinket) plus the 6 new page-4 items from the
   2026-08-11 "expand the play space" pass (Gae Bolg, Masamune, Muramasa, Balance Ring, Empress
   Hairpin, Ninja Tekko), with 3 new columns (CDR%, True Dmg, Lifesteal%) for their new mechanics.
   Verified every row directly against packages/simulation/arena_game.c's ARENA_ITEMS array, not
   guessed. Updated the Shift+1/2/3 shop-page keybind row to Shift+1-4 (verified generically
   correct in apps/arena/src/main.c, no hardcoded page-3 assumption).
3. Fixed a real, separate bug found while reading the file: the "Full Technical Design Document"
   section (original vertical-slice spec, ~600 lines) existed as two full copies back to back --
   one raw/unformatted with broken code-fence boundaries, one properly formatted -- almost
   certainly debris from an earlier bad edit. Removed the broken raw duplicate, kept one clean
   formatted copy (still retained as historical design capture, not deleted outright).
title: Full README refresh: new work documented + accidental content duplication fixed
